author: Mid City Times
title: Rep. Brandon Gill introduces impeachment articles against federal judge over alleged abuse
text:
Congressman Brandon Gill of Texas’s 26th District has introduced articles of impeachment against Chief Judge James E. Boasberg of the United States District Court for the District of Columbia. Gill accuses Boasberg of abusing his judicial authority to target conservative lawmakers, organizations, and individuals.
“Chief Judge Boasberg has compromised the impartiality of the judiciary and created a constitutional crisis,” said Rep. Gill. “He is shamelessly weaponizing his power against his political opponents—including Republican members of Congress who are faithfully serving the American people within their jurisdiction.”
Gill further stated, “Judge Boasberg was an accomplice in the egregious Arctic Frost scandal where he equipped the Biden DOJ to spy on Republican senators. His lack of integrity makes him clearly unfit for the gavel. I am proud to once again introduce articles of impeachment against Judge Boasberg to hold him accountable for his high crimes and misdemeanors.”
According to Gill, Judge Boasberg facilitated Special Counsel Jack Smith FBI’s project Arctic Frost, which allegedly spied on several Republican senators and Representative Mike Kelly.
The articles have 11 co-sponsors: Fine, Roy, Donalds, Boebert, Luna, Biggs, Self, Stutzman, Crane, Ogles, and Collins.
Boasberg was appointed as chief judge by former President Barack Obama. Earlier in March 2025, Gill also filed impeachment articles against Boasberg after he blocked President Trump’s use of the Alien Enemies Act—an action that would have led to deportations of violent criminal illegal aliens. According to Gill’s office, this included halting flights midair and ordering them back to return foreign gang members such as those from Tren de Aragua and MS-13.
Brandon Gill secured his seat in Congress after winning 62.1% of the vote over Ernest Lineberger III in the 2024 general election.
